purpose: The bank of real-world phrasings that generated drafts are titled from. Every title this repo produces for a new draft is DRAWN from this bank, never COMPOSED from a stem plus a suffix. One phrasing is consumed by at most one piece, ever.
why: On 2026-08-08, 54 pages were removed from the public sitemap. Every one of the 54 mappings in reports/BING_INDEXATION_CONSOLIDATION_REPORT.json carries duplicateHtmlTitle: true. The defect was a parent title plus a rotating editorial suffix ('A Gentler Truth To Consider', 'What This Looks Like In Real Life', 'Next-Step Reflection'). This file exists so that mechanism cannot come back: there is no suffix to rotate, because there is no composition step.
provenanceRule: Every family must name a live cluster id in data/intake/query_clusters.json or a live lead-intent tier in data/search/target_queries.json. _ops/validators/validate_title_uniqueness_contract.js hard-fails if a family points at research that no longer exists, so this bank cannot drift away from the pipeline that justifies it.
usageRule: scripts/lib/demand_titles.js draws phrasings in research-ranked order and marks each one consumed against data/admin/content_manifest.json. When the bank is exhausted for every live family, generation STOPS with a named reason (DEMAND_POOL_EXHAUSTED) and the bank must be replenished from new research. It never falls back to a template.
